extraction.Name: Josephine Delia De Cory Rogers
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: No, I didn't mortgage it. Yes, it is sold.
extraction.Buyer: Land was sold to Mr. Tackett (W. H. Tackett); consideration was over $2,700; a house was received from W. H. Tackett; $1100.00 was paid in cash for a car by first husband Mr. Ferrin against allottee's will
extraction.Occupation/Income: By my husband, Mr. Rogers; He is clerking in a store at St. Francis.
extraction.NOTES: Allottee states: 'I really didn't want my patent; my husband got it for me, and he made more use of it than I did.' First husband Arthur Ferrin brought patent home; money from land sale deposited by first husband in Todd County Bank in his own name instead of allottee's. First husband paid $1100.00 cash for a car against allottee's will from land sale proceeds. Allottee has four children dependent on her. Allottee is in good health. Document signed May 21, 1929, before a notary public in Todd County, State of South Dakota.
